messages:
observability-bot: [ALERT] hosted-gateway us-west-2: sustained p95 tail latency > 4s, 504 rate x3, request-queue depth 98% for tenant=snapdesk. automated detection: continuous-batcher backlog growing.

support_eli: customer INC-3245 just opened a prod ticket — users seeing frequent timeouts, urgent. linking logs. :warning:

jessica-sre: I'm pulling the queue metrics now. looks like a long-running KV cache spinup causing per-request dequeue delays. batcher backlog rising steadily for ~16m.

samir-platform: can you paste the tail traces? suspect continuous-batching window is keeping requests queued waiting for batch fill.

jessica-sre: logs:
```
2026-03-17T10:14:12Z gateway: enqueue id=abc123 tenant=snapdesk queue_len=987 depth_limit=1000
2026-03-17T10:14:18Z batcher: hold_for_batch ms=4000 pending=320
2026-03-17T10:14:19Z handler: dequeue wait_ms=3800 result=timeout
```

anika-prod: policy note: hosted pool queue_depth hard limit = 1000. We hit the soft-shed threshold earlier and started rejecting after spiking. but p95 tails are well before reject threshold — so slowness not just rejects.

kevin-ml: model variants in use: rdx-large-1 quantized. Large seqs + quant overhead + long prefix reuse could make batching slower. fallback plan: route heavy requests to rdx-medium or enable fast-path kernel.

support_eli: customer says it started after they ramped a nightly ingestion job ~10m ago. might be tenant-specific spike.

jessica-sre: repro steps I'm running against a host to reproduce:(1) send 800 concurrent short-chat requests with similar prompts; (2) simulate long prefix kv warm; (3) observe batcher hold and queue depth. repro is stable locally.

samir-platform: quick mitigations: (A) enable emergency tenant rate-limit for snapdesk to 50rps; (B) reduce continuous-batcher hold window from 25ms to 5ms for host pool; (C) temporary model fallback to rdx-medium. Which do we want now?

anika-prod: Do A + B immediately. C if A/B not enough. Also notify sales/CS. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/queue-overflow (see section "emergency-shed-and-fallback").

jessica-sre: applied A and B at 10:21Z: throttled snapdesk + lowered hold window. infra-bot shows batcher concurrency rising but queue depth trending down.

infra-bot: action log: tenant-rate-limit set tenant=snapdesk limit=50rps by jessica-sre at 2026-03-17T10:21:04Z. batcher-config updated hold_window_ms=5 by jessica-sre at 2026-03-17T10:21:09Z.

kevin-ml: also pushed a fast-path kernel for rdx-large-1 on the pool; should reduce per-token time for long-prefix cases.

jessica-sre: metrics update 10:27Z: queue depth dropped from 98% -> 34%, p95 tail latency from 4.2s -> 320ms, 504 rate back to baseline. Customer reports partial improvement.

support_eli: told snapdesk CS to validate UX during the next 30m. ticket updated. :thumbsup:

anika-prod: postmortem notes: need tenant-aware ingress throttles, dynamic queue-depth per-pool, and smarter batching policy for heavy-seq tenants. Filed followups: ENG-PLAT-211 (adaptive-depth), ENG-RUNTIME-432 (batcher heuristics).

jessica-sre: leaving thread open for 1h for stability. will rollback emergency limits after 30m if stable. thanks everyone.

support_eli: noted, closing customer escalation if no regressions in 45m.
